texts.li: {A_nameDef} stood very still while {X_indefinite} settled on the fence beside {A_objective}, its wings opening and closing like slow breathing.
On the way back from the fields, {A_nameDef} walked straight into {X_indefinite} drifting from flower to flower, and had dust from its wings on {A_possessive} sleeve for the rest of the day.
[x:race:AA_AuroraSylph] After dark, {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} hang above the field like a curtain of green light, and stayed out until it drifted away.
[x:race:AA_EmpressButterfly] {A_nameDef} followed {X_definite} along the garden beds, and could have sworn the soil was darker wherever it had landed.
[child] {A_nameDef} chased {X_definite} across the yard with both hands cupped, and came back with empty hands and no breath left.
At a dead run, faster than any horse, {X_indefinite} went past {A_nameDef} and was gone. Afterwards {A_nameDef} found one of its feathers in the grass, longer than {A_possessive} arm.
{A_nameDef} came over the rise and nearly walked into {X_indefinite}. They looked at each other for a long moment; then the bird snapped its beak once and strolled off.
[x:race:AA_RoyalAve] Caught on a bush was a plume from {X_definite}, so bright it looked dyed. {A_nameDef} has pinned it over {A_possessive} bed.
[x:race:AA_FrostAve] Against the wind, {X_definite} fluffed itself up until it was twice its size, and {A_nameDef} laughed out loud.
[skill:Animals] {A_nameDef} spent the afternoon watching how {X_definite} moves and eats, and came back sketching a pen big enough to keep one.
{A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} graze its way along the edge of the fields, unhurried, as if the colony were a strange kind of rock.

[x:race:AA_Thunderox] Out in the pasture, {X_definite} lifted its head and bellowed. {A_nameDef} knows what a thunderox's call is said to mean, and went to bring the washing in before the sky could turn.
[x:race:AA_ChameleonYak] Three times in one afternoon {A_nameDef} lost sight of {X_definite} against the hillside. Its coat had gone the color of the grass.
[x:race:AA_Radyak] The crystals growing through the hide of {X_definite} glittered every time it lowered its head to graze. {A_nameDef} stood watching until it moved on.
[x:race:AA_GreyCoatedMouflon] Standing near {X_definite}, {A_nameDef} felt {A_possessive} jaw unclench and {A_possessive} shoulders drop. The feeling went when the animal wandered off.
[x:race:AA_Gigantelope] Past the wall walked {X_indefinite}, its head higher than the roof. {A_nameDef} worked out how much it could carry, and sighed.
{A_nameDef} spent a good while watching {X_indefinite} drag its rock across the yard, one patient sideways step at a time.
[x:race:AA_PebbleMit] Wherever {X_definite} went, it left a trail of loose stone, and {A_nameDef} followed it round collecting the pieces for the builders.
[x:race:AA_CrystalMit] {A_nameDef} caught {X_definite} eating the gravel off the path and couldn't decide whether to be annoyed or impressed.
[x:race:AA_SummitCrab] A hill on the colony's land got up and moved. It was {X_indefinite}, carrying what looked like half a mountain on its back, and {A_nameDef} went no closer.
[child] {A_nameDef} sat on a rock for ten minutes before the rock got up and walked away. It was {X_indefinite}.
A shadow slid over {A_nameDef}'s work. Overhead, {X_indefinite} was drifting above the roofs, slow as a cloud.

[x:race:AA_ColossalAerofleet] With a soft thump, {X_indefinite} bounced off the colony's wall, turned, bounced off it again, and floated away. {A_nameDef} watched the whole thing with {A_possessive} mouth open.
[x:race:AA_Skyeel] With a faint crackle, {X_definite} flicked past {A_nameDef} through the air, and the hairs on {A_possessive} arms stood up.
[child] {A_nameDef} lay on {A_possessive} back in the grass and followed {X_definite} across the sky until {A_possessive} neck hurt.
Crossing the yard after dark, {A_nameDef} met a pair of eyes just beyond the lamplight. They belonged to {X_indefinite}, which held still until {A_nameDef} moved first.
[x:race:AA_DuskRat] Four small eyes glowed at {A_nameDef} from under the storeroom door, two pairs, one above the other. Come morning, {A_nameDef} went through the grain sacks looking for holes.
[x:race:AA_NightRam] Once the sun was gone, {X_definite} came down to graze, and {A_nameDef} sat on the wall and watched it, both of them quiet.
[x:race:AA_CrepuscularBeetle] Through the dark, {X_definite} trundled past the colony like a cart with no driver. {A_nameDef} stepped aside to let it by.
The ground shook. {A_nameDef} looked up to see {X_indefinite} walking past the colony, taller than anything the colony has ever built, and put down {A_possessive} tools until it had gone.
{A_nameDef} watched {X_definite} from the wall until it was only a shape on the horizon. Afterwards {A_pronoun} couldn't say how long it had taken.
Out on the mudflats, {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} pick its way between ribs as tall as trees, the bones of something that came here to die long ago.
In the hollow of an enormous skull, out of the sun, {A_nameDef} found {X_indefinite} sheltering, and left it in peace.
{A_nameDef} lay in the grass under the giant flowers and watched {X_indefinite} graze nearby, close enough to hear it chewing.
From between flower stalks as thick as {A_nameDef}'s waist came {X_indefinite}, dusted yellow with pollen. It sneezed.
{A_nameDef} ducked under a mushroom cap the size of a roof for a moment's shade, and found {X_indefinite} had had the same idea.
In the green half-light under the giant mushrooms, {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} nose through the white threads on the ground, and kept well clear of the big caps and their spores.
{A_nameDef} saw {X_indefinite} freeze among the trees. A dozen eyes on the nearest trunk had turned to look at it. Then they turned to look at {A_nameDef}.
In the red haze under the trees, every time the eyes in the bark blinked, {X_definite} flinched, and so did {A_nameDef}. Neither of them stayed long.
